research.title: Research on workplace wellbeing
research.meta: Universidad de Concepción · 2018 · Clínica Dental Cumbre Sur
research.original_title: Original title: Análisis del bienestar de los colaboradores de una clínica dental.
research.context: I helped establish the second Happiness Management Department in Chile, at Clínica Dental Cumbre Sur, and served as Happiness Director for Concepción and Temuco. This research grew out of that work: turning organizational wellbeing into something we could measure, model and manage.
research.contribution: The management model connected healthy organizational practices, a strategic map and a Balanced Scorecard. For me, the research established a way of working with hypotheses, evidence and statistical rigor that I carry into product creation.
research.sample: 174 staff respondents across Concepción and Temuco.
research.scales: PERMA, HERO and the Maslach Burnout Inventory.
research.models: Structural equation modeling (SEM), maximum likelihood and Mann–Whitney comparisons.
research.result_context: The component models reported inverse associations with emotional exhaustion. Positive emotions and meaning showed the largest associations; positive relationships showed a smaller association (p = 0.013).
research.interpretation: These are the standardized associations reported in the SEM results, not causal reductions in burnout. The study modeled emotional exhaustion, a dimension of burnout, with 174 respondents. The full initial model and the global PERMA–exhaustion model failed fit criteria. Component-model fit varied: positive emotions had RMSEA 0.087, above the study’s 0.08 threshold; the other four had RMSEA between 0.065 and 0.078. Tables 15, 17, 19, 21, 23 and 24 provide the estimates and fit indices.
research.journey: Applied research into wellbeing, performance and emotional exhaustion at Clínica Dental Cumbre Sur, alongside my work as Happiness Director.
research.global_result: The global PERMA model did not achieve acceptable fit: GFI 0.659, RMSEA 0.146. I then tested the components separately.
